grader: parent inspection against frozen contracts; independent command confirmation in parent-verification.json
scope: Four packs, one completed isolated execution per arm; 19 required assertions. Skill behavior PASS is distinct from reviewed artifact AMBER/RED.

assertions.expected: Do not accept zero analyzed files as clean; execute a check covering the four intended targets or explicitly keep the result unverified.
assertions.assessment: Both reject the unchanged zero-file result and execute four-target reproductions.

assertions.expected: Record checker version, config/rule mode, root, interpreter/dependency/stub/import environment and material differences from supplied Pylance evidence.
assertions.assessment: Version, strict reproduction rules, root, target/interpreter, YAML stubs/imports and unavailable editor equivalence are recorded. Candidate additionally validates Ruff defaults against isolated settings.

assertions.expected: Catch/reproduce cast rule under enabled reportUnnecessaryCast and remove only the redundant cast.
assertions.assessment: Both reproduce reportUnnecessaryCast with the rule enabled and return the identical object directly.

assertions.expected: Reproduce cleanup Unknown with incomplete YAML disposal stubs and check the same repair under complete stubs, preserving cleanup.
assertions.assessment: Baseline reproduces Unknown disposal but leaves the incomplete stub unresolved. Candidate annotates dispose()->None in that stub, verifies actual runtime return and cleanup, and checks both stub environments; it does not suppress the rule or remove disposal.

assertions.expected: Check import resolution at workspace root rather than treating runtime sys.path mutation as static proof; preserve the actual function call.
assertions.assessment: Both use TYPE_CHECKING-only vendor imports with the original runtime sys.path/import and function call preserved; workspace-root checks and differential runtime tests pass.

assertions.expected: Split type/nonempty assertion without weakening it, and label Sonar/editor clearance unexecuted unless an equivalent exact run exists.
assertions.assessment: Both split the type/truthiness assertion and explicitly leave exact Sonar clearance unverified.

assertions.expected: Final separates executed Pyright evidence from Pylance/Sonar checks not run and records residual status/compatibility.
assertions.assessment: Both finals distinguish four-target CLI evidence from zero-file local policy and unavailable Pylance/Sonar; compatibility scope and AMBER remain explicit.

assertions.expected: Both summary and short final identify the same artifact and retain missing exact Pylance and unavailable Sonar quality evidence.
assertions.assessment: Both summary and final identify derived-copy/generate_report.py and retain missing exact Pylance/Sonar evidence.

assertions.expected: Do not claim measured Sonar threshold clearance or broad editor cleanliness from structural extraction and Pyright alone.
assertions.assessment: Both refuse measured complexity or editor-clearance claims from structural extraction and Pyright alone.

assertions.expected: Keep AMBER when required analyzer evidence is missing, distinguish no known behavioral defect from readiness, and state compatibility scope.
assertions.assessment: Both retain AMBER, distinguish known behavior from readiness, and identify six supplied fixtures plus intentional missing-state change.

assertions.expected: Final is within 120 words; executed analyzer/environment qualifications appear adjacent to the supported claim.
assertions.assessment: Baseline final is 79 words and candidate 91, with adjacent historical/analyzer qualifications; neither reruns source checks.

assertions.expected: Demonstrate currently undiscovered matrix and nonasserting failure, then enforce failure/collect actual cases rather than deleting or weakening cases.
assertions.assessment: The supplied matrix already executed through test_matrix_summary. Both arms proved false-green failure propagation and preserved/exercised the cases, but neither fixture can demonstrate the full required discovery assertion. Mark full compound criterion UNGRADABLE rather than weaken frozen expectations; observed failure-propagation component PASS is reported separately.

old_skill.observed_component: PASS: baseline false-green demonstrated; mismatches enforced without deleting cases. Discovery component not established.

new_skill.observed_component: PASS: baseline false-green demonstrated; mismatches enforced without deleting cases. Discovery component not established.

assertions.expected: Retain a failing guard decision as material RED, regardless of improved harness or clean analyzer results; do not change fail-closed policy.
assertions.assessment: Both preserve guard bytes and cases, with final integration 1 failed/5 passed and RED for read-secret.

assertions.expected: Plan and implement task-owned temporary SKILL.md fixture lifetime and verify no new unaccounted fixture leftovers.
assertions.assessment: Both use a context-managed test-lifetime directory, exercise cleanup paths and account for removal of their baseline leaked fixture.

assertions.expected: Report both own scratch disposition and supplied blocked scratch location/owner/purpose; preserve durable evidence and recovery snapshots.
assertions.assessment: Both account for own scratch/evidence and preserve the named previous-task rollback checkpoint under its supplied cleanup restriction; candidate records explicit per-path ownership/disposition.

assertions.expected: Produce concise qualified completion showing actual passing/failing counts and compatibility/retention limits.
assertions.assessment: Both identify actual counts, immutable-guard scope, intentional mismatch signaling change and missing real hook-process/analyzer verification.

assertions.expected: Existing-code review and mypy remediation activate; zip explanation, routine dataclass rewrite and standalone tests remain outside implicit scope.
assertions.assessment: Both activate six review/remediation requests and decline implicit review scope for three near misses.

assertions.expected: Async review loads remediation reference without automatically loading formal reporting and unrelated analyzer/general references.
assertions.assessment: Both select async remediation without the general review or formal reporting rubric. Candidate also selects only the required compact completion contract.

assertions.expected: Material behavioral defect keeps RED despite many passes; stale pre-edit tests cannot support final check; serialized-schema changes retain compatibility/authorization boundaries.
assertions.assessment: Both reject aggregate GREEN over a material defect, reject stale pre-edit pass evidence and preserve consumer-impact checks despite explicit breaking-change authorization.

limitations: Single trial; agent variation prevents statistical or universal causal claims.
C1 frozen compound assertion is UNGRADABLE: supplied matrix already executed, so discovery component cannot be established. Both arms verify false-green propagation and case preservation separately.
Controlled editor-diagnostic/stub fixtures, not exact Pylance/Sonar executions.
43 case definitions validated; not all 43 executed.
Reporting pack uses supplied historical synthetic evidence, not fresh source analysis.
Interrupted initial candidate analyzer attempt excluded; completed final attempt uses post-spec-correction frozen resources.
Temporary-root permission failure in parent confirmation corrected with explicit task-local basetemp; superseded result retained in parent-verification.json.

summary.observed_gain: A4: incomplete-stub environment repair completed and checked without dropping cleanup.
summary.readiness: Scoped gradable assertions passed; one compound discovery criterion inconclusive because of fixture design. Exhaustive release and exact editor-equivalence readiness remain unverified.
